meta.note: left and right rendered separately (not mirrored); do not use flipX
meta.feetPivotNote: footprint px relative to the feet pivot (origin), +y down; x,y = top-left

talk.role: play while the dialogue box is open

bottle_clean.note: Dips to set the tankard down and take a bottle (prop swap on frames 2 and 10, the lowest point). Facing down behind the bar the counter hides the swap; in left/right/up the swap is visible at knee height as a quick pick-up/put-down from a low shelf.

wipe_counter.downOnlyReason: Needs the bar top in front of him: the rag is lowered to the B1 tavern_bar_counter top line, which only exists as a south-facing (camera-facing) prop. In left/right/up he would be wiping empty air at thigh height. When Tharos faces left/right/up, pick another variant.

gesture.note: Facing left the wave uses its own per-facing beats (35<->75 deg forearm swing) so the far hand stays visible beside/above the head on every frame (2026-11-09 QA fix; other facings unchanged).

idleVariants.rule: loop idle; after a random 6-14 s pick a variant valid for the current facing (wipe_counter: down only), play once, return to idle at frame 0, re-roll the timer. Never while talk is playing.

meta.readability: shirt silhouette rim: shirt pixels within 4 px (manhattan) of the transparent exterior use shirt_md (#c2b090) instead of shirt (#d8cbb0); palette, design and lighting unchanged from Gate D
meta.gate: final sheets after Gate D approval (Nov 9 2026); not integrated
